translation.name: Diosa' kiika; Génesis, Éxodo y El Nuevo Testamento

content: Noénu sera' jimula
Pi bu'ware' dyañu, Noé' nala, Sem bain, Cam bain, Jafet bain na demiyandiñu, entsai sera' jila:
Entsalaa Jafet' nala deeve: Gómer bain, Magog bain, Madai bain, Javán bain, Tubal bain, Mésec bain, naa Tirás bain.
Entsalaa Gómer' nawaala: Asquenaz bain, Rifat bain, naa Togarmá bain.
Tsenmala Javán' nalaa Elisá bain, Tarsis bain, Quitim bain, naa Rodanim bain.

Entsalaa Jafetnu sera' jimu detiya' ma bululu chachilla vee vee ma uñichi uuden juu chumu detiya' lamaa keetala chumuwaala, tsenmin ma bulumee ma palaachi tene patimu chachilla debuudi', yala' tunu ma bululu paande i' chuchudimuwaala.
Cam' nalaya Cus bain, Misraim bain, Fut bain, naa Canaán bain.
Tsenmala Cus' nalaya Sebá bain, Havilá bain, Sabtá bain, Raamá bain, naa Sabtecá bain. Tsenmala Raamá' nalaya Sebá bain, tsenmin Dedán bain.
Cusya, entsa tunu mu' mityaba ajke' kayu daj ruku tiya' chumu Nimrodchi ya' apa tiyamuwaami.
Nimrod ura' yavi' jeen aingamu tiyamuwaami. Tsenñaa yanu laapu' patu entsandimu deeve: Ya bain yavi' jeen aingamu, matyu Nimrod tsaave, timu deeve.
Ya uñi tiya' ajke' uudenguen chunu pebululaya entsaa juntsawaala: Babel bain, Érec bain, Acad bain, tsenmin Calné bain Sinar tusha.
Tsenmin entsa tu tenasha chu' malutaa Asiriasha ji' pebulu dekemi: naa Nínive bain, naa Rehobot-ir bain, naa Quélah pebulu bain,
tsenmin Resen aa pebulu bain kemi, matyu Nínive bain, Quélah bain chunu kejtaa tenatala.
Misraimnaa desera' jila Ludnu sera' jimu chachilla bain, naa Anamnu sera' jimu chachilla bain, naa Lehabnu sera' jimu chachilla bain, naa Naftuhínu sera' jimu chachilla bain,

naa Patrusnu sera' jimu chachilla bain, naa Casluhínu sera' jimu chachilla bain, tsenmin Caftornu sera' jimu chachilla bain. Tsenmala Casluhínu sera' jimu chachillanaa Filisteasha chumu chachilla sera' jimuwaala.
Tsenmala Canaánya Sidónnu ajke' na miyandimi, tsejtu bene Hetnu bain miyandimi.
Tsenmala Canaánnu seralaa naa Jebús pebulunu chumu chachilla bain, naa Amor chachilla bain, naa Gerges chachilla bain,
naa Heve chachilla bain, naa Arac chachilla bain, naa Sin chachilla bain,
naa Arvad chachilla bain, naa Semar chachilla bain, tsenmin Hamat chachilla bain serala. Tsejtu bene kumuinchi Canaánnu bulu paande seramula na'baasa devela' jiila.

Canaánnu sera' jimu chachilla' tuya bare' tsetanchi ne kikemi. Tsa' mitya Guerar tu deechusha, Sidón pebulubi jumin Gaza pebulubi juumi, tsenmin Sodoma pebulu, naa Gomorra, naa Admá, naa Seboím pebulu deechusha bain jumin, Lesa pebulubi jingue bare' tse'kila.
Camnu sera' jimu chachilla ma bululu chachilla vee vee ma uñichi uuden juu chumu detiya', naa tu bain ma paande bulumeemee ka' dechu', main main naati vera' pamu deju'ba tsa tsai chumuwaala.
Jafetchi ya' uñaku Sem bain na miyandimuwaami. Kumuinchi Éber'
nalaa Semnu sera' jimu chachilla deeve.
Entsalaa Sem' na jumuwaala: Elam bain, Asur bain, Arfaxad bain, Lud bain, naa Aram bain.
Tsenmala Aram' nalaya Us bain, Hul bain, Guéter bain, naa Mas mumu bain.
Arfaxadya Sélahchi ya' apa tiyamuwaami, tsenmala Sélahya, Éberchi ya' apa tiyamuwaami.

Tsenñu bene Éber bain pai na miyandimuwaami: mainya Péleg mumuwaami, matyu ya' tinbunu chumu chachilla develadeiñu' mitya (hebreo palaachiya Péleg titu, “veenu” titundive), tsenmala Péleg' bennaya Joctán mumuwaami.
Joctán' nalaya Almodad bain, Sélef bain, Hasar-mávet bain, Jérah bain,
Hadoram bain, Uzal bain, Diclá bain,
Obal bain, Abimael bain, Sebá bain,
Ofir bain, Havilá bain, tsenmin Jobab bain. Kumuinchi entsala Joctán' na tene juwaala.
Tsejtu Mesábi tu miyalan, Sefar detiñu, matyu pajlainsha kuyi tene junainsha tu jina bare' tanamuwaala.
Semnu sera' jimu chachilla ma uñichin uuden juu chumu detiya', naa tu bain ma paande bulumeemee ka' dechu', main main naati vera' pamu deju'ba tsa tsai chumuwaala.

Entsalaa Noé' nalanu sera' jimu bulu paande jumuwaala, matyu ya' nalanu main main desera' ji' ma tenana chumula. Tsangue' Dios pi bu'ware' dyañu, bene Noé' nalanu sera' jitaa naa nukaba desera' ji' ma bulumeemee ma uñichin uuden juu chumu chachilla detiya' chula.

footnotes.text: 10.14 Hebreo palaachi pilla kiikanuya, Filisteasha chumu chachilla Casluhínaa desera' jive tive, tsaaren Amós 9.7nuya Caftornaa sera' jive tive. Uwain entsa pai bulu chachillanu desera' jilaa tenve.
10.21 Éber mumunu laapu' pataa hebreo chachilla timu deeve.
